title: Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies Dissolution Amendment Ordinance 2023

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies Dissolution Amendment Ordinance 2023
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 177
PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 177
ORDINANCE I OF 2023
PUNJAB UNDESIRABLE COOPERATIVE SOCIETIES
(DISSOLUTION) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2023
An Ordinance to amend the Punjab Undesirable
Cooperative Societies (Dissolution) Act, 1993
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
12th April, 2023]
No.
Legis:13-190/2012(P-I), dated 12.4.2023.---The following Ordinance promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is
hereby published for general information:
It
is necessary to amend the Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies
(Dissolution) Act, 1993 (I of 1993) for regulating various provisions thereof
and for purposes hereinafter appearing.
Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session and Governor of the Punjab is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action.
In
exercise of the powers conferred under clause (1) of Article 128 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be cited as the Punjab Undesirable Cooperative Societies
(Dissolution) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2023.
(2) This
Ordinance shall come into force at once.

Provincial

In

Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
5. Insertion
of section 17A to Act I of 1993.---In
the Act, after section 17, the following shall be inserted:
"17A.
Special Court.---(1) An offence punishable under this Act as specified in
the SECOND SCHEDULE shall be exclusively triable by the Special Court
authorized by the Board with approval of the Lahore High Court, who shall be
the District and Sessions Judge of relevant district.
(2)
The provisions of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (V of 1898) shall,
except Chapter XXXVIII of the Code, apply to the proceedings of the Special
Courts.
(3)
The provisions of Chapter XX of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (V of
1898) shall apply to trial of cases under this Act.
17B.
Appeal.---An appeal against the order of the Special Court shall lie before
the Cooperatives Judge within thirty days from the date of the order.".
